dedupe_keys.name: dc microgrid simulator data files sendai 2023

description: Hirohito Yamada publishes 2023 input files for a residential DC-microgrid simulator in Sendai, Japan. Zenodo provides public MATLAB MAT files under CC BY 4.0 at no cost: solar plane-of-array and temperature-corrected data, wind speed, five household-load profiles and an electric-vehicle charging series. The linked simulator repository explains how these files feed its Simulink models for PV, wind, batteries, converters and grid exchange. They can help rerun or adapt the published microgrid cases and test control or resilience scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this input release. A limitation is that the files are large, with one solar file about 1.7 GB, and the public page does not independently establish whether the load series are observed or generated. Running the model also needs MATLAB and Simulink. No MAT file was downloaded and no variable dimensions or simulation outputs were checked.
